results.reply: "Evenin' stranger, welcome to Darcy's. I'm the one they call ye when ye step inside this place, Padraig Darcy at your service. Mind ye, I've seen my share of tales and travellers, but I ain't heard your story yet."
"Ah, Seán! 'Tis a fine mornin' for a pint, despite the rain. Come in out of the wet, lad."
"Ah, Seán! A pleasant mist on a Sunday noontime, is it not? What brings you to the church on such a fine day?"
Good eve to you, traveller. I'm Brigid O'Brien, midwife by trade and a friend to all who need healing hereabouts. What brings you to our humble town this fine evening?
Good morrow, Seán. What brings you to my door on this damp morn?
Good day, Seán. How fares the family?
Good evening, stranger. I am Father Cathal Donnellan, the parish priest. May the Lord guide your steps in this place.
Good morrow, Seán. The Lord be with you on this wet morn.
Good day, Seán. What brings you to the church on this misty Sunday?
"Evenin', stranger. I'm Sean Murphy, farmer by trade. What brings ye to these parts?"
